sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: Phase 1 (fundamentals; committed before any market number)
sections.markdown:
**Priors disclosure:** market narrative = JSMR is the state bellwether whose AFFO never clears the sovereign yield and whose 35% JTT cession plus BI hikes make that permanent — cheap for a reason.

**EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate (re-run):** no special-notation/ppk hit (idx.co.id 403 again; prior Jun-2026 clean stands). Related-party: ~70% Kementerian BUMN vs 23.7% float; BUMN-JV builders (Hutama Marga Waskita, Jasamarga Gedebage Cilacap) optics-only; Waskita-KPK history pre-dates this management. Structure: no rights issue since 2016; JTT 35% sold to Metro Pacific/GIC (Rp15.75tn; tranche-2 Dec-2024) = permanent NCI drain, not dilution; ISAK 16 concession intangibles (PSAK 73 not applicable). Accruals not computable (CFO unreachable — prior gap); margin proxy flat (EBITDA 67%, core profit flat ~Rp3.7tn FY24→25). No manipulation flag; PASS with disclosed gaps.

**Regulatory:** biennial CPI+SPM ministerial tariff (UU 38/2004 Art.48(3); PP 23/2024; recent cycle 5.05% realized CPI; 20 segments guided 2026) — mechanical lagged passthrough, no pricing power; deferral risk low to 2027, rising 2028-29. 16 concessions ~1,736km, ~1,264km ops; 5 new-builds keep capex Rp10-12tn/yr; maint-vs-expansion split unisolatable (prior gap persists).

**AFFO build (FY2025 toll basis, Rp tn; committed):** rev 19.8 (+5.8%); EBITDA 13.3 (67%); cash interest −4.0 (blended ~6.3% on ~Rp64tn avg gross, mid of 62.5-press/78.1-yfinance); cash tax −1.2; maint capex −1.5 (~8% toll rev, assumption) → **AFFO 6.7 base / 5.4 stress** (interest 4.9 @ 6.5% on 75tn; maint 2.0). DPS 156.2, 31% payout, ~3.2x covered. **Load-bearing unresolved: gross debt Rp62.5tn (press) vs Rp78.1tn (yfinance) — Rp15.6tn gap moves AFFO ~Rp1tn and the gate below.**

sections.heading: Market state & EV — Phase 2
sections.markdown:
Price 2,540 = 52-wk LOW (2,530), −39% from 4,180 high; mcap Rp18.43tn (7.26B sh); float 23.7%; ADV ~Rp25bn/d; flows STALE (fund record empty). 10y FR 7.16% (2026-10-02, TradingEconomics; −10bp vs 7.26% at prior kill). Net debt ~63tn (55.4 press / 71.0 yfinance); EV ≈ 74-89tn.

**Gate re-run — the dispositive question:** base AFFO 6.7tn / EV 74-89tn = **7.5-9.1%** vs 10y FR 7.16% → clears by +0.3 to +1.9pp (press-debt end). Stress AFFO 5.4 / same EV = 6.0-7.3% → **fails −1.2pp at yfinance-debt end, +0.2pp marginal at press end**. At BI 6% (marginal debt ~8%) the base spread erodes to ~+0.6pp. Verdict: **gap narrowed from clean-fail (prior 5.4-7.2% vs 7.26% at a 1.5-2.0x-debt EV heuristic) to a thin base-case pass hostage to the debt figure and rate path** — the floating-debt-vs-2y-lagged-escalator mismatch is unchanged, merely smaller at this price.

**EV math:** 0.55 reg → 0.35: −10pp rate regime unchanged (BI 5.75 held, 6% chatter; Fed +25bp 09-15/16 12-0; DXY 101.92 at 52w-high); −5pp debt gap (25% of one debt figure unverified — stress trips gate); −5pp JTT NCI (holder AFFO diluted ~35% vs consolidated optics). Symmetry up/|down| = 26/11.4 = 2.28 vs library 1.75 — richer, no defect. Own-Kelly 6.5% vs library-Kelly 29.3% — the deviation is the sizing haircut. Expected +17.9%/3y ≈ **+5.6%/yr < FR 7.16% and far under house ~11% equity hurdle → sub-hurdle long.**

sections.heading: New evidence
sections.markdown: Price −6.6% to the 52w low; 10y FR −10bp; 2026 tariff cycle proceeding; BI held 5.75% twice (no delivered hike); debt-shape gap (Rp15.6tn) surfaced, cuts both ways. Gate: marginal-pass at base, fail at stress — narrower than the prior clean fail, not resolved.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown: **Market believes:** JSMR is a failed bond-proxy — worth the 6.2% dividend and little more; JTT cession plus BI hikes make the AFFO-fail structurally permanent. **Why wrong:** at the 52w-low the market prices the STRESS case (6.1%, sub-sov); the base case (8.2%, +1pp) with a 5.5% net dividend and the mechanical 2026 tariff reset is not in price — a state network yielding ~135bp over the sovereign at its low is over-discount, and the gate holds on base inputs. **What proves us wrong:** FY2026 LK cash interest >Rp5tn or gross debt >Rp78tn; 2028 tariff deferral; BI ≥6.5%; further discount minority sell-downs.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **Rate regime** (the macro regime memo 2026-10-03): BI 5.75% held to 6% chatter; Fed +25bp to 3.75-4.00; DXY at 52w-high; carry +162bp — archetype's dominant failure (leverage+rising rates) stays ACTIVE; the floating tranche reprices quarterly vs 2y-lagged CPI tariffs.
2. **Debt-shape gap:** yfinance 78.1tn vs press 62.5tn unadjudicated; at 78.1 & 6.5% interest, stress AFFO 5.4tn = 6.1% at current EV — 1.1pp under 10y FR 7.16% (TradingEconomics 2026-10-02): the killing gate still fails on conservative-plausible inputs.
3. **Chronic grind, not washout:** 2,540 is the 52-wk LOW after ~12 months of decline (high 4,180), 17.4% institutions held; flows STALE — cannot separate capitulation from information; "cheap" is the base rate of a levered regulated operator, not fresh forced selling.
4. **NCI drain:** 35% of the flagship JTT network's cash flows permanently accrue to minorities; consolidated-EV AFFO math overstates holder economics.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: 2029: position down ~12% to the kill. Path: BI 6.25% in 2027; FY2026 LK prints debt >78tn, cash interest >5tn; base AFFO ~6tn; sub-hurdle EV grinds the multiple; dividend held but the income leg repriced as failure — my 52w-low entry mistook a chronic grind for a washout.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**BEAR ATTACK — Drew (BEAR), 2026-10-03T12:00:00+07:00 (kill-ledger revisit; JSMR is NOT on the 2026-10-03 INDO screen — no dossier exists; primary-source claims checked against T-INDO-JSMR-001 and packet quotes; unverifiable items flagged below)**

0. FACT-CHECK: EV 74-89tn recomputes (18.43 mcap + 55.4-71.0 net debt); 10y FR 7.16% verified (TradingEconomics 2026-10-02). Base AFFO "6.7" recomputes to 6.6 from the thesis's own inputs — minor slip. But the 7.5-9.1% band pairs the yfinance-debt EV (89) with the mid-debt AFFO (6.7): an inconsistent pairing that manufactures the floor. No fabrication-class finding.

1. ESTIMATES: re-run at the yfinance end (gross 78.1, avg ~76): interest 6.3% ≈ 4.8 → base AFFO 5.8; EV 89.4 → **6.5% < 7.16% — the BASE case fails**, not merely stress. Second, independent cut: the gate runs consolidated AFFO, but 35% of JTT (the flagship network, T-001) accrues to Metro Pacific/GIC — holder AFFO ~1.5-1.8tn lower (my estimate, JTT 60-70% of EBITDA) → ~5.0-5.3/74-89 = 5.6-7.2%, failing to marginal at BOTH ends. **Fragile — single-assumption dependency, twice over.**

2. VARIANT PERCEPTION: method card pt 5 — "model it as a bond with growth options, not a compounder." ~135bp over sovereign for floating debt, 2y-lagged tariffs, a 70% state owner, and 2028-29 deferral risk is compensation, not over-discount. The "new evidence" is price −6.6% and FR −10bp: the gate didn't improve — the entry price fell to meet a still-failing gate. A falling knife with flows STALE: capitulation is unobservable.

3. BASE RATE: key mislabeled — post-JTT cession this is dividend_income_anchor economics (a 5.5% net-dividend trade), and infra_tower_compounder's own registry notes name "leverage + rising rates" as the dominant failure = the current regime. Moot anyway: the analyst's own EV is sub-hurdle.

4. SIZING: +5.6%/yr vs 7.16% FR and the ~11% hurdle — dead on arrival at its own arithmetic, and unfixable by construction: target +26% already sits near the archetype's capped +35% 3y upside; hurdle-clearing needs ~+40%+. down_pct −11.4% is the exact kill print; ARB-lock fills 1-2 bands below 2,250 (~−11.8/−12.2%) plus slippage on Rp25bn/d ADV put realized loss ~−13% (pre-mortem itself says −12%). Understated.

5. DISCONFIRMING (new): Brent 102.7 war premium intact (the macro regime memo, Severin commodity block, 2026-10-03) keeps ID fuel costs elevated — toll traffic is fuel-price elastic, and fuel-price politics is the historical trigger for tariff-deferral pushback (2024 Jakarta-Cikampek 35% hike criticism, T-001). Next FOMC Oct 28-29 could extend the carry squeeze (fed_path marker armed).

6. PRE-MORTEM steelman: the avoided failure mode is recapitalization. Capex Rp10-12tn/yr ≈ 2x AFFO with no trophy asset left to sell post-JTT; a BI-6.25% refinancing wall (Rp10.6tn short-term, T-001) forces a 2016-style rights issue at 52w-low prices — diluting the very per-share AFFO this gate was run on.

7. ANTI-GAMING: stage_log clean (draft → attacked); estimates committed 10:30+07 with no market data in Phase 1. Two arithmetic slips (6.7 vs 6.6; kill-note "~6.7% net yield" vs actual ~6.25% at 2,250) — looseness, not gaming. No QC escalation.

8. VERDICT: **KILL_RECOMMENDED.** On the unadjudicated Rp78.1tn debt figure alone the base AFFO yield is 6.5% against a 7.16% sovereign, and after the JTT minority drain this is a sub-sovereign-yielding equity its own analyst rates below hurdle — the July kill at 2,720 is being marked right, not wrong.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: KILL. Reason tag: valuation.**

**Standing correction applied** (my ledger: 24 kills / 0 passes, killed names averaging +7.0% above kill price — the over-kill record). I tested this kill for gains-left-on-the-table before anything else: none exist. The prior kill at 2,720 is vindicated by a further −6.6% to the 52-week low, and this thesis's own arithmetic (+14.9%/3y ≈ 4.7%/yr) sits below INDO cash 5.5%, the 10y FR 7.16%, and the ~11% hurdle — against every alternative, including doing nothing, the kill costs nothing. No correction is triggered; the record's disease is not present in this case.

**Protocol:** chain complete — lint PASS (one tolerated WARN: 1878 words, all from the verbatim Bear log), stage_log monotonic draft→attacked→revision→judged, revision 292 words, all nine Bear points (0–8) answered, and no raised p_up/up_pct/target anywhere in the revision: every change moved *against* the thesis (p_up 0.35→0.30, down_pct −11.4→−13.0). LESSON-0002 applied: the first kill's reason is not wrong — it is confirmed at a 6.6% lower price. This is a vindication, not a repeat-on-deterioration kill.

**Independent stress** (the shared-context risk: what could author and Bear BOTH be wrong on?): the gate itself. It is the method card's law — AFFO must clear the 10y FR *with a spread that compensates the leverage* — so anchoring on it is discipline, not shared bias. At the press-debt end (62.5tn), consolidated base AFFO 6.6/73.8 = 8.9% passes — but the 35% JTT cession is document-fact (Rp15.75tn, Metro Pacific/GIC, T-001) and survives the debt question: holder AFFO fails-to-marginal at both EV ends. FR −25bp: base 6.5% still fails, holder marginal only at the top; FR +25bp: everything fails. BI ±25bp moves ~Rp26bn on the floating tranche ≈ 4bp of EV yield — immaterial either direction. A pass needs press debt AND a half-strength NCI drain AND −25bp on the sovereign simultaneously, and even that corner yields <1pp spread for a 4.7x-levered floating-rate name inside the macro AVOID tilt — no leverage compensation at all. The kill survives every stress.

The July kill at 2,720 is being marked right, not wrong. The 60-day cooldown attaches as machinery but is moot on a dead idea: resubmission only by the sponsoring analyst with material new evidence — an adjudicated gross-debt figure from the FY2026 audited LK, a BI pivot, or a 2026 tariff surprise — never price.
